messages:
maria: Heads-up — product planning to GA Kestrel v1.3 next Tue 10:00 PT. They expect ~2.5x token/sec vs current Llama variants. Can SRE/infra estimate GPU and networking impact and list mitigations?
jonah: Quick read: if current similar traffic baseline is ~40k tokens/s, 2.5x => ~100k tokens/s peak. They report avg tokens per request ~160–200; I'll use 180 for calc. Rough concurrency ~ 100k / 180 ≈ 555 req/s.
alex: Mapping to GPUs: with our runtime tuning we see ~9k–12k tokens/s per A100-80GB (mixed perf depending on seq length & batch). Using conservative 9k => ~12 GPUs sustained, 18 for burst buffer. That matches Jonah's concurrency estimate with batching.
liyah: Region quotas: eu-west has only 40 A100 quota left across all projects; we can't push entire fleet there. We'll need cross-region routing to split 60/40 US/EU or use smaller quantized variants in EU.
maria: Notes: can we avoid wholesale capacity reservation? prefer autoscale with prewarm to reduce cost. What's expected GPU-hours delta?
jonah: If we run 12 GPUs steady for the 3-month launch window: 12 * 24 * 30 ≈ 8640 GPU-hours/month. Prior baseline was ~3 GPUs steady => ~2160 GPU-hours/month delta ≈ 6480 GPU-hours/month extra. At $3.75/GPU-hour infra cost estimate => ~24.3k/mo incremental GPU cost.
alex: Also factor in prewarm pods during rollout; add ~3 GPUs for the 2-hour canary => +6 GPU-hours per canary deploy.
liyah: Networking: NLB connection limits in ap-northeast are tight; we should up the per-node conn limit and increase Nginx worker_rlimit_nofile. Also watch TCP ephemeral port exhaustion on old nodes.
sre-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-03-24 10:00 PT — canary then 4h progressive rollout. Links: https://dash.redwood/insights/kestrel-launch (monitoring).
maria: Mitigation plan suggestion: 1) Canary with 1% traffic to quantized-kestrel (4-bit) variant; 2) Autoscale target set to maintain p95 latency < 350ms; 3) Prewarm 6 GPUs in US 30m before GA; 4) Route EU traffic to quantized variant until we free quota.
jonah: I'll update capacity spreadsheet with region splits + exact GPU counts and post a short runbook for runbook on-call. Expect to request temporary quota bump in EU if product insists on full regional presence.
alex: Ops action items: - add autoscale policy override; - create prewarm job: `kubectl create job prewarm-kestrel --from=cronjob/prewarm --env=MODEL=kestrel-1.3`; - open support ticket for NLB limits.
maria: Thanks — assign owners: jonah -> capacity spreadsheet & quota request, alex -> prewarm job + nginx tweaks, liyah -> routing rules for quantized fallback. Ping me when tasks are in PR. :thumbsup: :warning:
